lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: I have a question.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Oh my, you have a question? That's quite unlike you.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Now that the Queen has come into play, I can't just let it go.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Fine, I'll answer as best I can.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: What is this "coronation" you speak of?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It's when one puts on the crown.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: So, what you're saying is, you're helping Marian become the Queen?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Given the gravity of what we're discussing, could you put a bit more thought into your questions?

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Whyyyyyy?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: What I meant was for you to add your own deductions, piece the situation together, and ask questions as you do so.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Are all these things related to Scarlet?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Probably not, I think.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Then it's fine. I'm not interested.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... *Sigh*

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Listen carefully, Rose.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Hehe. So eager to speak, aren't you?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Because I'm tired of this. And I'm disappointed.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Disappointed in the Queen?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Well... I understand she drifted through space for over a century because of an accident.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I understand her brain was failing, and she needed a new one.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Unfortunate, certainly. Unexpected, perhaps.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: But you see... since then, the Queen has become a coward.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She could've corrected her orbit and descended to the surface right away.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: But she didn't.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Why? Because she was afraid.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: "What if Cinderella is still alive?"

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: "What if there's something stronger than Cinderella?"

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Those fears stopped her from acting.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: As for the veil over her eyes, she could have torn it away if she truly wanted to.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: But she didn't.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Why? Because she was afraid.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: "What if I'm attacked while weakened, after lifting the veil?"

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: That fear left her frozen.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Even with her vision blocked, she could have descended to the surface.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Just adjusting her orbit would have been enough.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: But she didn't.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Why? Because she was afraid.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: "What if I fall because I can't see?"

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: "What if I land among them?"

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Who are "they"?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Oh, never mind that.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Anyway, she didn't come down to the surface because she was scared.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It was like that back then, and it's still the same now.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She could come down this very instant and turn the tables, but instead, she just watches from way up above.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Why? Because she's a coward.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: "What if Eden's Spear is fired again?"

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: "What if there's more than one?"

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... Because of Cinderella, the Queen lost her nerve.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: That fear left the surface with no Queen for far too long.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The Raptures and Heretics started to run rampant.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I worked tirelessly to restore order.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Ugh, cleaning up after others is honestly the worst.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You're telling me.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: After spending far too much time doing that,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I couldn't take it anymore.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Yeah, that makes sense.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: So I took it upon myself to make a Queen.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Then... I tried a little of this and that.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Fortunately, a Queen came into being.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: That's why I want to make Marian the Queen, no matter what it takes.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: And you don't want to be the Queen yourself?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Pfft, as if.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: For starters, I'm nothing but a data-based lifeform with no corporeal body.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: This form is just a mimic of the person whose personality data I'm based on.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Honestly, that's just an excuse.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The truth is, I want someone I can control to be the Queen,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: so I can watch from the sidelines while still intervening at crucial moments.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: In other words, you want a puppet?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Like me?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Don't put yourself down like that.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The reason why I revived you is very obvious.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You can cut down Raptures, human imposters, and humans alike.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You are, quite literally, my bodyguard and my sword.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Isn't that what you'd call a puppet?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I prefer the term "proxy".

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hehe. Do you know the one thing I learned from my base personality data?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Never lose your patience, and never take matters into your own hands at critical moments.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: If someone else had handled it from the start, there would have been no risk at all.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Now who's the coward?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I'm not like that coward up there.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I don't just tremble in fear. Instead, I prepare for what comes next.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Isn't that far more forward-thinking?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Supplies are here!

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Oh, thank you. Place them there.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: How about the bread and meat?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Open wide! Here it comes!
*Chomp!*

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
!!
Delicious!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Do you have enough ingredients?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I'm fine for now. Do bring some next time, if you please.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: They're in my room—

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: It's the second one from the bottom in the biggest box, right? I'll grab it next time.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: ... How did you know that?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Don't you remember? I'm a spy!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Anyhoo, I'm off! Take care!
Harran absentmindedly watches Papillon run off, laden with supplies.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: If you have coolant, hand it over.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Snow White, that's not for consumption.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: ... It's to keep me from overheating; I'm not going to consume it.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: ... Oh, sorry.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Hmm. It hardly seems to be decreasing.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Yeah. They keep coming endlessly.
Harran swings her scythe.
A black mist spreads out, visibly slowing the Raptures.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Guess we'll need one hell of a big shot to turn this around, huh?
*Boom!*
Snow White's Seven Dwarves spew fire, and the Raptures are swept away.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Do we have any way to handle this?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Hmm, doesn't seem like there's anything right now.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Then all we can do is hold them off until someone finds a solution.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: All right. Let's give it our all, shall we?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Supplies are here!

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Bring the energy packs over here.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Where's Scarlet?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Over there.
Papillon looks toward where Isabel is pointing.
Scarlet swings her sword like she's dancing at the center of the Rapture horde.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... She's still out there? Isn't she gonna get some supplies?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: She already came back twice.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Each time, she had a drink and went back out.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: So alcohol is basically her fuel?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I suppose so.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Oh. Hold still, I've got this.
Papillon lifts an energy pack and injects it into Isabel's feather.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Tired?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: You've got this.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: ... What's come over you?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Nothing much. Just doing my thing.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: As you know, combat isn't my specialty.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: So I'll run supplies until my feet are sore, or do whatever grunt work Cecil gives me.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: You could always run away.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: You want me to cross that sea of Raptures? Don't be ridiculous. I'm no Pilgrim.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: There is a route. You can see it too, can't you?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Aren't you running away?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: If I manage to see the Queen, I could get fast-tracked for promotion, right?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Eden, a Pilgrim, and the Queen—that's gotta be worth a triple rank jump, don't you think?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Haha, I suppose so.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: How's Eden doing?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: They say Eden's Spear will be ready in about two hours.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: ... Two hours.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: That should be doable, right? Since you're all nutjobs, anyway.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Of course.
*Beep beep*

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: All right, recharge complete.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Than—
*Slap!*
Papillon smacks Isabel hard on the butt.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: All right! Let's get moving!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Did that hurt?

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: ... Next time, give me a heads-up.
Isabel shoots up into the sky in an instant.
Heading toward the battlefield, she tears through the sky.
Scarlet lands in front of Papillon.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Hah... Since Lady Isabel hath come, I'll bide me here a spell and take mine ease.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Do you need supplies?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Pray, pour me a drink.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Here. I've warmed it up for you.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Something wrong?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: To sip warm spirits in the midst of battle, 'tis indeed a rare luxury.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I shall partake most gratefully, Lady Papillon.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Take your time. I'll head to my next post.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Heh, thou hadst a rough time.
Scarlet absentmindedly watches Papillon run off, laden with supplies.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: *Sip*

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Ahh...

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Well then, let us take up our sport anew.
Scarlet sets her cup down, adjusts her grip on her sword, and charges at the Raptures.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Supplies!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: *Pant!* *Pant!* Why are you all the way up here?!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: We never know when the Queen might fire her beam.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Pfft, of course we'll block it.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... You two are going to block that? That thing's huge! How's that even possible?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: At the very least, we should be able to protect Eden's Spear.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... Well, that is if we actually manage to block it.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: What's the matter? Losing your nerve? All that high-and-mighty preaching, and now you're scared?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Hehe, I'm always scared.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Hmph. Pathetic.
Papillon peeks over the railing, looking down.
The height makes her dizzy. Below, a swarm of Raptures gathers.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Can your attacks even reach them from here?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Barely. We're mainly targeting the aerial-type ones flying this way, but even that's... well...
A swarm of aerial-type Raptures suddenly charges at breakneck speed.
Isabel deploys her feathers and slices through the horde in a single motion.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: She's got them all covered.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Perfect. I guess I'll stay here.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I guess the safest place would be wherever the strongest shield is.
Papillon looks over the railing once more.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... So that means the four Pilgrims are keeping all those Raptures down there at bay.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Hehe, that's about right.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... You guys are absolute lunatics.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Hey, over there.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Is something there?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Nayuta's coming. On a camel.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: My, you've got such sharp eyes.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: A spy's gotta have good eyesight, after all.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: And behind her... is that Nihilister being carried?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: No, I don't think so...

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Here... tic...

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: It's Modernia!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... Excuse me?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: M-Modernia! She's carrying Modernia!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: The outfit's a bit different, but those bandages and that hair color...!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: It's definitely Modernia!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: What in the world...!?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Yikes...! She's really been put through the wringer...! A total mess...!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Who!? Marian!?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Marian? Oh, you mean Modernia.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Yeah, she's a total wreck. At this point, you could almost say she's been minced—

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Noah! Sorry! I'll be back in a sec!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Huh? Uh... s-sure.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: It's not like I get anxious being alone... not at all.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I'll stay here. You go quickly.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Okay! Thank you!
Rapunzel darts off.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Why are you here if you're no help?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I don't like being alone. It freaks me out.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: ... Hmph.
